description: This file defines the 'RecordNotFoundException' class, a custom exception used within the OrangeHRM system to indicate that a requested record was not found. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides default error messages.

classes.name: RecordNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a specific record was not found in the system. It inherits from PHP's Exception class and provides default error messages for use within the application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a default message or a provided message, along with optional code and previous exception for exception chaining.
